title: Push window ops docket — pre-flight + actions
content:
Purpose: single-page prep for the pre-flight and the final go/no-go call. Personal checklist + talking bullets + immediate actions I own. Use this during the 1:1 with the launch marshall and for the final 10-min decision meeting.

Topline objective:
- Ship release train 2026-03-15 push window (models: open-llama-70b-q4 + cache-warming) with 2-hour canary, auto-fallback to s1-small if latencies degrade.

Quick mental note (what I will say in the meeting):
- "We are green on infra capacity, amber on quantized model perf (spikes in p95 seen), green on observability. Recommend canary with 10% traffic for 2 hours, metrics hold for 15m steady state before full ramp."

Personal preflight checks (run this in order, call out if anything fails):
1) Infra & capacity
   - Confirm Dedicated pool scaled to target (check autoscaler logs + GPU allocation): ping Carlos if mismatch.
   - Run quick smoke: curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"smoke\"}' -> expect 200 and <300ms baseline on canary nodes.
2) Model artifacts
   - Verify checksum for model bundle (sha256): model-70b-q4-v2 -> owner: Liu.
   - KV-cache priming plan exists? yes/no. If no -> schedule immediate warm-up job (Priya).
3) Observability & alerts
   - Dashboards loaded: latency, errors, token-cost, mem-gc.
   - Pager thresholds set: p95 > 1200ms or error rate > 0.5% triggers P0.
4) Canary config
   - Traffic slice 10% for 2 hours, canary rollback gates at 15m, 30m, 60m.
   - Canary failure -> automatic rollback to s1-small across region.
5) Rollback & runbook
   - Rollback playbook link: confluence:RT-2026-rollback (open during call).
   - DB / infra migration? NONE in this push. If that changes, abort.

Red/Amber/Green quickscore (my view):
- Serving runtime: GREEN (autoscaler warmed, nodes OK)
- Model performance (qq quantized): AMBER (p95 jitter during long-context smoke)
- Observability: GREEN (dashboards & tracing hooks validated)
- Billing & quotas: GREEN (rate-limit buckets tested)
- Security & keys: GREEN (KMS rotations accounted)
- External deps (partner auth, s3): GREEN

Go / No-Go criteria (hard blockers = NO-GO):
- Hard NO-GO if any of:
  * model checksum mismatch or missing artifact
  * critical alert firing (p95 > 2x baseline) at decision time
  * missing or invalid canary routing rule
- Soft blockers (require mitigation + documented risk and owner):
  * amber model perf (can still go with tighter canary + extended monitoring)

Canary metrics to watch (owner in parens):
- p50/p95 latency (Carlos), error rate (Liu), token throughput (Priya), token-cost-per-req (Billing), OOMs/evictions (Infra SRE oncall)
- Thresholds: p95 < 1.2s, error rate < 0.5%, token-cost within +20% of baseline

Rollback criteria (if any one triggers -> rollback):
- sustained error rate > 1% for 10m
- p95 > 2s for 5m and trending up
- backing store (S3) 5xx > 0.5%
- model correctness regression on smoke prompts (manual check)

Handoff / escalation plan (call tree):
- Launch Marshall (primary): Priya Nair -> owns the go/no-go call
- Infra escalation: Carlos Rivera -> handles autoscaler/GPU issues
- Model & runtime: Liu Chen -> handles model artifacts and perf tuning
- On-call SRE: team-oncall@redwood.ai -> paging policy: P0 immediate page, P1 async message
- Exec: me (Maya) to brief Simon (head of product) if major impact

Immediate action items I own (with due times):
- Maya: prime KV cache job script and run one 30m before canary (due: T-40m)
- Carlos: validate autoscaler logs and confirm pool size (due: T-60m)
- Liu: re-verify model bundle checksum and run golden prompts (due: T-90m)
- Priya: open the launch-room and post runbook links + Slack thread (due: T-60m)

Meeting script (quick):
- 00:00-02:00 (me): TL;DR status by green/amber/red and any hard blockers
- 02:00-05:00 (Priya): Canary plan and rollback summary
- 05:00-08:00 (Carlos): Infra & capacity confirmation
- 08:00-10:00 (Liu): Model/artifacts & perf caveats
- Decision: call placed by Priya, consensus vote (green=go, amber=go with mitigations, red=stop)

Post-launch verification (first 30 min checklist):
- Confirm canary traffic diverted and stable at 10% for first 15m
- Check token-cost and p95 every 5m (Grafana panels A,B,C)
- Run 5 golden prompts from smoke set and sanity-check outputs (Liu)
- Confirm no increase in customer-facing errors (SLO panel)

Parking lot / questions for the weekly sync:
- Do we want to automate the KV warm-up as part of deploy pipeline? (longer term)
- Should we add a token-cost circuit-breaker in the router? (product ask)
- Can we add a small synthetic load generator to canary to detect p95 regressions faster?

Notes to self (quick reminders):
- If model perf is amber, explicitly propose: reduce to 5% canary and extend to 3 hours OR enable quantized fallback.
- Keep decision language crisp: say either "green to proceed" or "hold and remediate" — avoid hedging in front of execs.

End of docket — update after the call with final decision + timestamp and then convert action items into Jira RT-2217 subtasks.
